column1: # The AZs in which a ladder type may be launched other than its spec's pinned AZ, for the one
# capacity retry of make ladder-campaign (docs/ladder.md, "The campaign") and AK2_LAUNCH_AZ in
# run.sh / run-multi.sh (docs/run.md, "Launch overrides"). A row is documented by its evidence: a
# committed manifest that launched exactly this type in exactly this AZ (ladder_levers.py az-alt
# checks it). File order is the retry's preference order: the most recent successful launch first.
# r8gd.48xlarge and r8g.48xlarge have no launch outside us-west-2b on record, so they have no
# alternative: a capacity failure on them stops the rung and is reported.
